name: Vibe Karon
shortDescription: Off-plan resort condominium in central Karon with 309 studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, a pool, spa and clubhouse.
description:
Marketed as Vibe Residence Karon, a resort-style condominium of 309 apartments on a site of about 5,500 sqm in central Karon, around 1 km by road from Karon Beach. The advertised range runs from studios of about 35 sqm to two-bedroom units of 62-72 sqm.
Shared facilities include a pool, spa and sauna, fitness centre, bar, clubhouse, indoor kids zone and on-site restaurant, with hotel-style management and a reception. Completion is announced for October 2028.
Sources describe the layout differently (one portal does not give building details), so the building configuration is not stated here. A similarly named project, Vibe Downtown Karon, is a separate development.
